PROP-6a4369e9-inv-048.text: Between successive reads of a peer's custody_group_count within checkPeerCustody, the value must not change due to concurrent metadata updates. If lookupCgcFromPeer is called multiple times within one logical operation, either the value must be read once and cached, or the function must tolerate mid-call changes without entering an invalid state.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-048.assertion: forall peer, call_sequence in checkPeerCustody: all lookupCgcFromPeer(peer) calls within one invocation observe the same value OR the function handles mid-call changes safely

locations.note: Calls lookupCgcFromPeer multiple times within one invocation (lines 319, 327, 330, 338, 342). If peer metadata is updated concurrently between calls, different values may be observed, leading to inconsistent custody decisions.
Reads live peer.metadata on every call — no snapshot/caching within caller context.
